purpose: Edits a person's Email, Phone, Social and Skills rows, any number of each.
namedChanges: The imports are the peers': `add-your-own`, `card-group` (`CardGroup`, `CardIconName`), `card-mode`, `contact-actions` (`phoneForUri`, `resolvableSocialHref`, `toMailtoHref`), `contact-rows-model`, `one-card-context` (`useAddInPlace`, `useOneCardOwn`), `one-card-rows` (`YourRow`), `open-popups`, `remove-control`, `term-origin`, plus `./contactRowsHost` and the unit's own copies.
At the start of `ContactRows`: `const host = useContactRowsHost();` and the destructuring of the ten host members; in `PresentRow`: `const { SocialLogo, socialPlatformName } = useContactRowsHost();`.

ADDED BEHAVIOUR (production always has the writer): no `saveRecordSidecar` makes the section read-only. Before: `canEdit = canEdit && !!metaKey;` and the save function goes on to `contactRowsPatch`. After: `canEdit = canEdit && !!saveRecordSidecar;` follows the first line, and `if (!saveRecordSidecar) return Promise.resolve(false);` follows the save function's `metaKey` guard. With the writer nothing changes.
ADDED BEHAVIOUR: no `noteServedVersion` notes nothing. Before: `noteServedVersion(recordId, etag, served.meta);`. After: `noteServedVersion?.(recordId, etag, served.meta);`.
ADDED BEHAVIOUR: no `PhoneValue` shows the plain phone text. Before: `canEdit ? (<PhoneValue .../>) : (text)`. After: `canEdit && PhoneValue ? (<PhoneValue .../>) : (text)`.
ADDED BEHAVIOUR: no `SkillPickerSheet` draws no picker. Before: `{picking && createPortal(<SkillPickerSheet .../>, document.body)}`. After: `{picking && SkillPickerSheet && createPortal(...)}`.

ADDED BEHAVIOUR: no `SkillDepthNote` draws no note. Before (presentation row): `<SkillDepthNote .../>`; after: `{SkillDepthNote ? (<SkillDepthNote .../>) : null}`. Before (edit row): `{skillNotes && (<SkillDepthNote .../>)}`; after: `{skillNotes && SkillDepthNote && (...)}`.

ADDED BEHAVIOUR: no `SocialLogo`, or no `socialPlatformName`, draws no logo and the label still shows. At both uses (the edit row and the presentation row function) before: `<SocialLogo platform={socialPlatformName(platformOf(r.value), r.label)} className=... />`; after: `{SocialLogo && socialPlatformName ? <SocialLogo .../> : null}`.

ADDED BEHAVIOUR: no `HeldVisibilitySwitch` draws no switch. At both uses the condition `C` becomes `HeldVisibilitySwitch && C` (presentation: `HeldVisibilitySwitch && skillNotes.markFor(r.ref) === "private"`; edit: `HeldVisibilitySwitch && skillNotes && skillNotes.markFor(r.ref) !== null`).

ADDED BEHAVIOUR: no `AddedByLine` draws no line. At both uses the condition `C` becomes `AddedByLine && C` (presentation: `AddedByLine && skillNotes.sourceFor(r.ref)`; edit: `AddedByLine && skillNotes && skillNotes.sourceFor(r.ref)`).

`skillReferentUri` (named copy of the app's): the master's origin is read at the call from `term-origin` (the source read a constant); the pattern is built inside the function from `termOrigin()`, and the error words use `termOrigin()` and say "the platform refuses it".

`joinPhone` (named copy, FALSE FRIEND of `phone-text`'s `joinPhone`): the app's returns a national number that already starts with "+" unchanged; `phone-text`'s does not. Measured: 49 of 140 inputs differ. `toMailtoHref`, `phoneForUri` and `resolvableSocialHref` of `contact-actions` are equal to the app's on 32,915 inputs and are imported.
Comments that name a cycle, a ticket, an agent, a person, a ruling or the other app are reworded; no code changed.
